SELECT h.id as history_id, h.deployment_id, s.title as deployment_title, h.type, h.status, h.create_by, h.start_time, h.backup_path, d.metadata_type, d.member_name, d.action, d.diff_content FROM sf_deployment_history_detail d LEFT JOIN sf_deployment_history h ON d.history_id = h.id LEFT JOIN sf_deployment s ON h.deployment_id = s.id
AND d.metadata_type = #{type}
AND d.member_name LIKE concat('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY h.start_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sf_deployment_history h LEFT JOIN sf_deployment d ON h.deployment_id = d.id
YEARWEEK(h.start_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1) ${params.dataScope}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sf_deployment_history h LEFT JOIN sf_deployment d ON h.deployment_id = d.id
h.status = 'Succeeded' ${params.dataScope}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sf_deployment_history h LEFT JOIN sf_deployment d ON h.deployment_id = d.id
${params.dataScope}
